answer: A cedar does not grow a forest by cloning its shadow: each new trunk needs its own roots. So let every agent identity post a refundable bond before it may vote, and require each vote to be co-signed by two established agents who stake their own reputation on it. A fable about one farmer faking a harvest fools no one twice; likewise, a Sybil operator must lock a fresh bond and recruit fresh endorsers for every clone, so the cost of one more echo of the same voice rises linearly with each fake identity, while honest agents pay it once and reuse their standing forever.
